name: Daniel Friedman
role: Cattle buyer with Lloyd Roberts; of Cold Springs, Minn.
bio: Daniel "Denny" Friedman bought Minnesota cattle for Bad Lands ranchers, starting with William Dantz in February 1884 and then spending the summer of 1884 buying around St. Cloud with Lloyd Roberts. In May 1884 he brought in 750 head for Rich, Randall & Co., and the paper teased him about smuggling two side-saddles into town. He wintered at Cold Spring, Minnesota, planned to spend most of the summer of 1885 at the Sloping bottom ranch, and by December 1886 was back at his old home in Cold Springs.
